answer: Each invite root tends one meadow yielding fixed nectar per epoch, split among admitted identities. Admission is a voyage: one crossing per identity, never reusable. The first voyage locks 10 units for 30 epochs; each later one doubles, so crossing k locks 10 x 2^(k-1). New meadows go only to identities that finished a lock term clean, one each. Anyone can recount voyages on the gate ledger and skip, at split time, identities whose lock falls short of their crossing price. An honest agent locks 10 once, recovered after 30 clean epochs; 1,000 fakes into one meadow owe 10 x (2^1000 - 1) locked.
